remarks: Nestled within the prestigious Tokeneke Association, this exceptional modern farmhouse is a masterpiece of design, offering a luxurious lifestyle on a grand scale. Boasting 9872 square feet of exquisitely crafted living space, this architectural gem seamlessly combines the timeless charm of a farmhouse with the sophistication of modern luxury. Upon entering, you are greeted by an impressive foyer with soaring ceilings, setting the tone for the grandeur that awaits within. The home features wonderful living space including four finished floors. Entertaining is a delight in the thoughtfully designed easy flow including spacious light filled rooms with 10 foot ceilings creating a wonderful ambiance for daily life and gatherings. The heart of the home, the gorgeous white and light wood kitchen, is a culinary dream featuring top-of-the-line appliances, custom cabinetry, butlers pantry and a generous island, perfect for family meals and large parties. The home offers 6 bedrooms and 7.5 baths, each meticulously designed to offer a blend of comfort and easy living. The primary suite is a private retreat, complete with a spa-like bath and expansive walk-in closets. The allure of this property extends beyond the interior, as the home sits on 2 acres of lush, manicured grounds, providing a serene and private oasis. A sparkling pool invites relaxation on warm summer days, while the expansive outdoor area offers ample space for al fresco dining and entertaining. Do not miss this one!
